source_checkout: read-only; clean at exact pinned source revision
documentation_status: design consolidation; final runtime-backed documentation acceptance pending INT-DOC-02

source_requirements.behavior: The toolkit SHALL run a bounded one-CM/one-channel upstream reference experiment from source bits through the actual TX, channel and RX, then compare recovered meaningful bits independently.
source_requirements.acceptance: A completed and drained unity run recovers all generated meaningful bits with full contiguous coverage and zero mismatches; source counts, recovered counts and decoder flags are checked separately.

source_requirements.behavior: Normal receiver inputs SHALL contain received samples and legitimate accepted receiver configuration. They SHALL NOT contain source truth or injected channel/noise truth.
source_requirements.acceptance: Receiver admission tests exclude original bits, PRBS seed/ledger, injected H/C, RxMER targets and noise seeds/power; diagnostic truth is consumed only by separate comparisons.

source_requirements.behavior: Scientific algorithms, validation and orchestration SHALL execute in safe Rust independently of presentation or language runtimes. Adapters MUST NOT duplicate scientific calculations.
source_requirements.acceptance: Core-only build/tests require neither Python nor Qt; adapters contain no DSP/FEC/association duplicates, native DSP/codec FFI or unsafe simulation code.
source_requirements.test: Rust-only dependency/build inspection and no-unsafe guards

source_requirements.behavior: The toolkit SHALL distinguish representable settings, domain validity and executable support.
source_requirements.acceptance: Unsupported optional modes remain inspectable with reasons; execution rejects them before consuming input, random state or source bits; recognized QAM/code identifiers alone never imply a complete coding chain.

source_requirements.behavior: Scientific claims SHALL identify pinned evidence and the applicable endpoint without confusing internal closed-loop evidence with external interoperability. Each stage SHALL have source-checked expected inputs/outputs recorded before its implementation, independently of production tables/algorithms.
source_requirements.acceptance: Source/matrix/label checks record revision, section/page and source-review gaps; reports/docs label internal experiments accurately and retain optional-capability distinctions. Build these cases stage by stage; external interoperability fixtures and a complete upfront catalog are not prerequisites.

source_requirements.behavior: US Configuration SHALL retain a discoverable profile/preset inventory and explicitly select a one-CM/one-channel configuration shared by both endpoints.
source_requirements.acceptance: Rust inventory exposes every retained entry without hardcoded adapter catalogs; invalid selection preserves the prior accepted plan; inventory does not automatically create multi-preset trials.

source_requirements.behavior: Configuration admission SHALL produce an immutable CMTS plan and separate accepted TX/RX views through shared validation.
source_requirements.acceptance: Both views agree on permitted geometry/grant/pilot/PHY-seed settings while normal RX excludes source, C/update values and channel/noise truth; failure preserves accepted settings and readiness.

source_requirements.behavior: Generic OFDMA JSON SHALL have an explicit format/schema version, named presets, selection and separated normative configuration versus simulation settings.
source_requirements.acceptance: Schema/parser fixtures cover required/optional/null/default/unknown-field behavior, unsupported versions, bounded extension metadata and round trips; vendor IDs are optional provenance, never normative preset meanings.

source_requirements.behavior: Configuration coverage SHALL account for every applicable field/option in the pinned MULPI OFDMA scope.
source_requirements.acceptance: The field-level matrix records source path/page, endpoint, force/applicability, encoding/units/enums, JSON pointer, Rust owner, support state and independent fixtures; every inapplicable or unresolved row has an explicit disposition.

source_requirements.behavior: Typed and document-based configurations SHALL use equivalent domain rules and bounded admission. The first reference loop SHALL use typed synthetic configuration; JSON and verified capture loaders SHALL follow its acceptance.
source_requirements.acceptance: Invalid ranges, reserved values, inconsistent pilot/loading/geometry, associations and aggregate budgets reject atomically; valid synthetic configurations do not require an unverified capture decoder. Full applicable MULPI/JSON delivery remains required after the typed reference milestone.

source_requirements.behavior: Example presets SHALL demonstrate generic configurations without claiming universal recommended modulation.
source_requirements.acceptance: Reviewed 25/50 kHz, mixed-loading and zero-valued-minislot examples identify source versus engineering choices; ranging/probe examples explicitly state execution support; conditional/optional settings are not silently discarded.

source_requirements.behavior: The source SHALL emit continuous deterministic PRBS15 using the architecture's recurrence, seed range and bit order, independently of PHY scrambling.
source_requirements.acceptance: Literal initial vectors and the 32767-bit period pass for independently checked seeds; zero/out-of-range seeds reject; grants, words and chunk boundaries do not reseed the source.

source_requirements.behavior: Source consumption SHALL track accepted meaningful payload with checked absolute positions and bounded chunks.
source_requirements.acceptance: Fill/shortening/parity/pad/pilots consume no source bits; backpressure and rejected work do not advance the generator; chunked generation matches contiguous generation and overflow rejects before mutation.

source_requirements.behavior: Verification SHALL compare actual recovered meaningful decisions using an independently owned expected stream and validated source association.
source_requirements.acceptance: Wrong but valid codewords produce source errors even if parity passes; failures do not suppress available decisions; gaps/duplicates/reordering stop contiguous comparison explicitly without phase search or repair.

source_requirements.behavior: Verification results SHALL distinguish generated, compared and unverified bits, coverage, mismatch counts and completion.
source_requirements.acceptance: Zero compared bits yield unavailable BER; zero observed errors with partial/truncated/discontinuous coverage cannot claim complete recovery; retained results survive later operations.

source_requirements.behavior: Grant framing SHALL derive coded capacity and the upstream codeword sequence from accepted resources/loading while separating meaningful bytes, information-fill ones, shortening zeros, parity and zero grant pad.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent threshold/borrowing/boundary cases conserve bits and source consumption; RX derives the same layout from legitimate configuration; rejected plans preserve state.

source_requirements.behavior: Encoding SHALL use the selected source-verified upstream long/medium/short LDPC family with systematic order and exact shortening semantics. All three code families SHALL pass source audit and codec acceptance before dependent waveform implementation.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independently checked matrix entries/parity and full/shortened words pass; only appended shortening-zero coordinates are omitted; no downstream BCH or assumed puncturing is added.

source_requirements.behavior: PHY randomization SHALL use the defined 23-bit grant seed, first-bit/tap convention and per-grant reset over exactly the transmitted bit positions.
source_requirements.acceptance: Literal mask vectors, chunk continuity and reset tests cover parity and final grant pad; omitted shortening and known pilots add no clocks; invalid/reordered input preserves state.

source_requirements.behavior: QAM mapping SHALL form MSB-first cell words in accepted visit order using exact upstream labels, normalization and role-dependent loading.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent label/energy vectors cover the declared BPSK/QPSK through 4096-QAM scope including non-square orders; inactive resources consume no payload; unknown/unimplemented orders reject.

source_requirements.behavior: OFDMA framing SHALL apply the accepted pilot pattern, known signs, role/loading plan, block partitioning and joint interleaving/address order.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent masks, pilot vectors and permutation/bijection cases cover supported patterns, edge/body layout, exclusions, zero resources and boost exceptions; bit/cell totals are conserved and scaling occurs once.

source_requirements.behavior: Pre-EQ SHALL apply one accepted complex corrective bank after role scaling and before IFFT, preserving the distinction between C and injected H.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent normalization/phase/default/reset/replacement/adjustment cases pass; excluded carriers remain zero; stale bases/nonfinite/invalid banks reject; bank transitions occur only at accepted symbol boundaries.

source_requirements.behavior: IFFT SHALL transform complete accepted 2K/50 kHz or 4K/25 kHz physical grids at 102.4 Msamples/s using the defined centered unitary convention.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent direct-sum, tone, impulse and energy checks establish sign/bin order/scaling; useful sample count and timing are exact; inactive bins and invalid geometry are checked.

source_requirements.behavior: Sample assembly SHALL apply the specified CP/RP, cyclic extension, taper and overlap while retaining exact useful/prefix origins, burst edges, tails and explicit guards.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent numbered-sample/window tests cover zero/nonzero RP and adjacent symbols; complete output is invariant across chunks/backpressure; invalid geometry rejects and cancellation retains honest partial status.

source_requirements.behavior: Channel admission SHALL validate finite indexed sample blocks, clock, identities, continuity and budgets before changing state.
source_requirements.acceptance: Stale/duplicate/overlap/unexplained-gap/nonfinite/overflow inputs reject atomically; empty blocks are no-ops, not finish; unsupported composition rejects before TX consumption.

source_requirements.behavior: Initial unity transport SHALL preserve sample bit patterns and metadata exactly without impairments or random draws.
source_requirements.acceptance: Bitwise tests include signed zero and arbitrary chunking with unchanged indices/rate/burst/tail/guard/validity; empty/disabled impairment settings use the same bypass.

source_requirements.behavior: The response extension SHALL apply the declared causal synthetic complex FIR without implicit normalization, circular wrap or per-symbol resets.
source_requirements.acceptance: Literal complex convolution/impulse/delay cases establish phase, original origin, state continuity and exact terminal drain; zero/deep-null responses remain valid destructive experiments.

source_requirements.behavior: Residual synthesis SHALL offer explicit Off, sample-AWGN and restricted RxMER-derived modes using separate deterministic noise state and declared reference power.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent power/statistical/draw-order tests cover seeds, missing-carrier policy and pilot/role scaling; initial RxMER synthesis rejects nonunity C/H or incompatible timing across the complete schedule.

source_requirements.behavior: The timing extension SHALL implement only the designed integer delay, constant phase and CFO with emitted-sample-clock continuity.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent impulse/tone/rotation cases establish signs/origin, chunk/pause continuity and exact delay drain; zero mode is bitwise bypass; fractional clock and stochastic phase noise remain unavailable.

source_requirements.behavior: Channel output SHALL retain indexed samples and bounded passive observations while separating diagnostics from legitimate RX inputs.
source_requirements.acceptance: Observer selection/capacity does not change samples or randomness; output validity/partial/drain metadata is retained; injected H/noise settings never become hidden RX corrections.

source_requirements.behavior: Burst framing SHALL derive timing from accepted RX configuration and preserve actual indexed blocks and explicit missing intervals.
source_requirements.acceptance: Literal origin/stride/window cases pass; unexplained gaps/reordering reject; declared gaps retain coverage loss rather than becoming available zero samples; no hidden timing search is performed.

source_requirements.behavior: Useful-symbol extraction SHALL select exactly the scheduled N-sample windows without silently filling incomplete windows.
source_requirements.acceptance: Numbered-sample/CP/overlap/truncation cases distinguish available zeros from missing samples and retain the correct symbol identities and unavailable outcomes.

source_requirements.behavior: FFT SHALL produce raw physical bins using the inverse of the accepted centered unitary TX convention.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent complex-sum, signed-tone, impulse and energy cases establish bin/sign/scaling correctness and preserve availability metadata without injecting channel truth.

source_requirements.behavior: Channel estimation/equalization SHALL estimate effective C×H from received known pilots using the declared FrameFlatLs or FramePilotLinear policy and explicit zero-forcing validity.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent complex-anchor/interpolation/notch cases verify known pilot gain/sign treatment, estimate coverage and unavailable outputs; no hidden supplied-H, fast within-frame tracking or noise-estimation capability is claimed.

source_requirements.behavior: Resource extraction SHALL independently invert the accepted resource/interleaving order and preserve unavailable scheduled cells and their bit positions.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent mixed-loading/permutation/boost cases conserve order/counts; missing cells are not compacted and known amplitude is removed once.

source_requirements.behavior: Soft demapping SHALL produce MSB-first finite MaxLog natural-log P(0)/P(1) metrics from shared upstream labels/scales and a valid ReferenceVariance.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent label/distance/sign tests cover positive-favors-zero convention, configured saturation, ties and zero-confidence erasures; nonpositive/nonfinite variance rejects.

source_requirements.behavior: Soft derandomization SHALL independently regenerate the grant mask and reverse LLR signs before LDPC without changing magnitude or position.
source_requirements.acceptance: Mask-one metrics reverse sign; erasures stay zero; every transmitted position including pad advances the mask, while omitted shortening/pilots do not; word ordering and grant resets remain exact.

source_requirements.behavior: LDPC integration SHALL restore shortening exactly once through the existing codec contract and retain real decoder outcomes.
source_requirements.acceptance: Retained-length inputs, independent shortening cases and 1..100 iteration bounds pass; convergence, syndrome, shortened-zero consistency, failed decisions and actual iterations remain distinct; controls act between indivisible codec calls.

source_requirements.behavior: Information deframing SHALL remove only receiver-known residual fill and retain actual complete/partial/failed meaningful decisions and coverage.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent byte/fill/short-word cases preserve positions and continuity; failures are not dropped; source association/comparison happens outside normal RX.

source_requirements.behavior: Imported observations SHALL preserve original bytes, hashes, timestamps, exact grids, nulls, identities, units and reference/provenance.
source_requirements.acceptance: Original input remains recoverable after decode/selection/replay; malformed, incompatible and oversized inputs reject without replacing accepted state; upstream formats need pinned evidence and lawful fixtures.

source_requirements.behavior: RxMER SHALL support explicit single selection, power-domain averaging and bounded scheduled hold/interpolation policies over multiple captures.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent conversions/weights/time-boundary/null cases match resolved power and coverage; original capture times stay unchanged; synthetic replay time is separate and importing more files does not create trials implicitly.

source_requirements.behavior: US-Pre-EQ SHALL support a single fixed bank, multiple snapshots and multiple explicitly based initialization/adjustment updates.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independent complex/base/reset tests reject stale, missing or ambiguous dependencies; immutable schedules apply complete accepted banks only at defined symbol boundaries and preserve probe/source associations.

source_requirements.behavior: Combined input preflight SHALL validate the entire selected playback/update plan against channel/receiver support before execution.
source_requirements.acceptance: A later incompatible Pre-EQ event fails preparation even if the initial bank is compatible; RxMER targets, corrective C and injected H remain separate; no unsupported composition is silently enabled.

source_requirements.behavior: Shared Rust QAM and SA instruments SHALL inspect bounded real stage observations at named TX/channel/RX reference planes.
source_requirements.acceptance: Query results identify run, configuration, tap, grid/sample units and retention coverage; absent history remains unavailable; instrument enable/disable/query does not alter waveform, RNG or decoder behavior.

source_requirements.behavior: Scientific results SHALL distinguish measured observations, analytical/model inputs, receiver estimates and simulated FEC/source outcomes.
source_requirements.acceptance: Reports preserve convergence/parity/known-zero/source-error distinctions, failed words, actual iterations, partial coverage and provenance; zero observed error uses an explicit status rather than fabricated finite RxMER or JSON infinity.

source_requirements.behavior: Future workbenches SHALL present PRBS, CM-US-TX, CH-SIM and CMTS-US-RX in path order with separate US Configuration and PNM Files inputs.
source_requirements.acceptance: Stage navigation opens the corresponding defined stage; shared QAM/SA actions route to actual selected taps; source-only acceptance never marks the entire experiment ready.
source_requirements.source_owner: [Workbench organization](architecture.md#planned-upstream-signal-path-and-workbenches); DEV-UI-PLAN-01 after scientific prerequisites, then a separately approved UI implementation checklist.
source_requirements.owner: apps/qt (upstream UI owner deferred; no files authorized)

source_requirements.behavior: Editors SHALL distinguish draft and accepted settings, keep loading/apply idle and preserve accepted state on cancel/invalid apply.
source_requirements.acceptance: Accepted readiness uses text as well as color; preview consumes no active source/random state; displayed results distinguish complete, partial and discontinuous coverage.
source_requirements.source_owner: [Source lifecycle/presentation](architecture.md#lifecycle-and-prbs-tx--prbs-rx-presentation); SOURCE-01, DEV-UI-PLAN-01, then a separately approved UI implementation checklist.
source_requirements.owner: apps/qt (upstream UI owner deferred; no files authorized)

source_requirements.behavior: The high-level Rust API SHALL expose typed idle session, configuration/inventory/selection, input admission, preview and explicit bounded execution while preserving existing FEC entrypoints. This Rust session SHALL be developed alongside the backend and used for reference unity-loop acceptance.
source_requirements.acceptance: Direct Rust consumers exercise valid/invalid operations without CLI/Qt/Python; existing FEC imports, calls and schema-1 report semantics remain compatible.

source_requirements.behavior: The optional native Python API SHALL wrap working public Rust operations with equivalent domain validation and results. Native Python implementation SHALL begin after the Rust unity loop passes acceptance.
source_requirements.acceptance: Real native calls cover configuration, single/multi inputs and execution; no Python DSP/association/decoder implementation or subprocess sidecar is used; Rust-only dependency checks exclude binding runtimes. No early FEC-only Python wrapper is part of the selected delivery order.

source_requirements.behavior: Both APIs SHALL return owned results and structured domain errors using native language conventions.
source_requirements.acceptance: Error categories/details match without parsing messages; Python uses exceptions/None and checked integer/buffer conversions; outputs remain valid after later calls, input release and session disposal; zero-copy claims require lifetime proof.

source_requirements.behavior: Native Python execution SHALL release the interpreter lock during long Rust work and serialize mutable session access with explicit Busy behavior.
source_requirements.acceptance: Actual native concurrency tests demonstrate independent cancellation/progress access, deterministic Busy for competing calls and session restoration after normal/error/cancel exits; no Python callback executes inside core locks.

source_requirements.behavior: Rust and Python contracts, examples and Python type declarations SHALL describe the same implemented capability set.
source_requirements.acceptance: Independently executed bounded native runs match resolved settings, seeds, provenance, status, FEC outcomes and partial coverage with declared numerical tolerances; actual extension exports match `.pyi`/typing metadata and paired examples run.

source_requirements.behavior: Exported/configuration documents SHALL use explicit independent versions and declared compatibility rules.
source_requirements.acceptance: Unknown versions/typed fields reject or follow an explicit migration; no FEC report is reinterpreted as configuration/workbench; any later shared saved experiment runs through both APIs without dropped settings or manual conversion.

source_requirements.behavior: Runs SHALL freeze accepted settings with distinct run/configuration identities and deterministic independent source/noise state.
source_requirements.acceptance: Repeated runs with equal seeds/settings reproduce declared deterministic outputs; observers/chunking do not affect science; stale results or cross-session IDs are rejected.

source_requirements.behavior: Cancellation/failure SHALL preserve completed science and identify incomplete or not-started work under bounded safe work quanta.
source_requirements.acceptance: Stage-boundary and between-word cancellation tests retain actual completed results/counts, pending tails/ranges and partial status; no forced thread termination or invented completion is used.

source_requirements.behavior: Pause/resume, when exposed, SHALL preserve all scientific stream state and define paused-time and stop-from-paused semantics. Bounded cancellation and partial-result acceptance SHALL precede pause/resume delivery.
source_requirements.acceptance: Tests retain PRBS/mask/permutation/Pre-EQ/RNG/history state and pending output across pause; controls remain unavailable in an API until its safe-boundary/lifecycle contract is implemented. First-loop readiness MUST NOT depend on pause/resume; later exposure requires state/time/stop-from-paused tests.

source_requirements.behavior: Inputs, expanded plans, per-call work, cumulative runtime/memory, output queues and retained observations SHALL be bounded before allocation/execution.
source_requirements.acceptance: Existing architecture budgets and independently checked overflow/exhaustion cases reject without state mutation; final cumulative job budgets are documented before execution support.

source_requirements.behavior: Reusable code/tooling SHALL preserve Apache-2.0 ownership and all applicable third-party notices, licenses and provenance. Reviewed reference-code adaptations SHALL remain locally owned and MUST NOT introduce an external source-checkout or former-product runtime dependency.
source_requirements.acceptance: Dependency/reuse/package review retains actual copied notices and modifications; GPL presentation code does not enter the independent scientific core; private PDFs/captures/build outputs remain excluded. Each adaptation retains source/revision/notices/modifications and passes independent upstream checks.
source_requirements.adaptation: Replace prohibition on depending on MERLIN with prohibition on external checkout/former product dependencies; retain local crate dependencies and existing Apache/MIT/GPL boundaries.

source_requirements.behavior: Development setup SHALL require explicit intent and provide read-only check/dry-run behavior on declared targets.
source_requirements.acceptance: Mode/host/pin/path/bounds/failure tests pass; inspection creates no caches or installs; apply obtains only missing declared prerequisites with pinned local Rust/locked sources; real fresh provisioning is verified separately.
source_requirements.test: existing setup tooling checks plus explicitly authorized target provisioning

source_requirements.behavior: Validation and delivery records SHALL state actual evidence and preserve reproducible local tooling.
source_requirements.acceptance: Required local gate passes with downloaded source/toolchain caches retained and stable Cargo build outputs retained after testing; hosted/native/package/interoperability claims require actual corresponding runs; prepared save commands do not imply commit/push/release execution.
source_requirements.test: complete existing validation gates, native Python/CLI/PNM and final inventories
source_requirements.adaptation: Retain stable Cargo outputs and caches under MERLIN policy; do not inherit mandatory source cleanup.

integration_tasks.title: Consolidate architecture, requirements, checklists and source records
integration_tasks.acceptance: Complete all source document/requirement/task dispositions, preserve downstream IDs/statuses/API clauses, resolve local links and dependency/coverage checks. Documentation only; final runtime correspondence remains INT-DOC-02.

integration_tasks.title: Establish reproducible unified-workspace regression baseline
integration_tasks.acceptance: Record exact source/target/toolchain/locks and run the existing MERLIN regression/analysis-only/examples/native API baselines. Source results stay separately labeled; no invented external interoperability.

integration_tasks.title: Review scientific source rights, notices and dependency contracts
integration_tasks.acceptance: Inventory each imported file/resource and transitive dependency with source/version/license/notices/modifications and artifact obligations; preserve Apache/MIT science and GPL Qt boundary. Resolve actual reuse permissions before import; retain both lock audits and pins.

integration_tasks.title: Audit function-level DSP/FEC reuse and final leaf placement
integration_tasks.acceptance: Map exact source/target symbols as SHARE/REUSE/ADAPT/SEPARATE/DEFER, check every numerical convention and consumer, settle concrete file/test paths, record compatibility/performance baselines and architecture-review decisions before scientific migration.

integration_tasks.title: Integrate independently source-checked upstream LDPC families
integration_tasks.acceptance: All three families pass original row/edge/frozen-parity, shortening, failed-decision/iteration/known-zero/truth cases in fec-codec; all downstream BCH/LDPC/NCP/PLC regressions pass. No BCH on ordinary upstream data, no regenerated golden expectations.

integration_tasks.title: Consolidate proven common numerical kernels
integration_tasks.acceptance: Prove FFT/bin/normalization, QAM/LLR, PRBS continuity, channel/noise equivalence for each extracted kernel; benchmark changed hot paths, preserve re-exports and downstream results. Create dsp only if justified; a documented direct-reuse/no-new-crate decision must pass the same equivalence checks.

integration_tasks.title: Register upstream PHY, typed configuration, grants and source
integration_tasks.acceptance: Local module registration, supported/domain-valid distinctions, complete source-field coverage and typed idle session foundation pass. Independent grant capacities, all three codeword families, fill/pad/source bookkeeping, PRBS phase/period/seed/range and rejection atomicity pass before waveform use.

integration_tasks.title: Migrate all eight upstream transmitter boundaries
integration_tasks.acceptance: Each US-TX-01..08 typed boundary passes independent source/order/label/pilot/permutation/Pre-Eq/transform/window vectors for both numerologies and declared supported orders/patterns, including chunk/state/invalid-input cases and exact source accounting.

integration_tasks.title: Migrate unity and supported upstream channel models
integration_tasks.acceptance: Unity is bitwise exact including signed zero/metadata/no-RNG; causal FIR, AWGN, restricted RxMER residual, integer delay/phase/CFO pass independent samples/powers, chunk/seed/observation/drain and whole-schedule rejection tests. Preserve source composition restrictions.

integration_tasks.title: Migrate all nine received-only upstream receiver boundaries
integration_tasks.acceptance: US-RX-01..09 pass configured timing/window/FFT, FrameFlatLs/FramePilotLinear, inverse resources, finite MaxLog, soft mask, shortening/LDPC and information coverage tests without hidden TX/H/C/source truth; missing data never compacts positions.

integration_tasks.title: Accept bounded upstream loop, observations and lifecycle locally
integration_tasks.acceptance: Actual MERLIN source→TX→channel→RX recovers independently compared meaningful bits for both numerologies and supported loading; retain real FEC failure/partial/coverage outcomes. Execute through the initial public Rust upstream session developed alongside the stages; final API convergence remains INT-RUST-01. Cancellation precedes pause acceptance; test state preservation, deterministic science, passive metrics/taps and bounded aggregate/retained work.

integration_tasks.title: Integrate source-derived upstream capture inspectors and decoders
integration_tasks.acceptance: Reuse verified pinned parser capabilities; UCD multipart/envelope, CCAP RxMER and applied/last-update Pre-Eq pass source-derived independent length/offset/scaling/sentinel/flag/overflow/original-byte tests locally. Unknown metadata remains inspectable; no guessed association.

integration_tasks.title: Integrate explicit measured association and playback
integration_tasks.acceptance: Complete-plan UCD/CM/CCAP-interface/grid/time mapping, source coverage, power-domain selection/average/hold/interpolation and corresponding-probe Set/Adjust schedules pass. Validate later events before consumption; actual captured-plan runs preserve originals and reject incompatible C/H/RxMER combinations atomically.

integration_tasks.title: Converge typed Rust APIs without downstream breakage
integration_tasks.acceptance: Public upstream operations and common lifecycle/error/provenance semantics pass native Rust tests, idle/Busy/ownership/bounds/unsupported/versioned-schema checks. Preserve every downstream import/entrypoint/report, optional analysis-only support and Rust-only independence.

integration_tasks.title: Expose upstream through the existing native Python distribution
integration_tasks.acceptance: Actual native extension exports/types/errors/owned results and independently executed Rust/Python runs agree, including configuration/captures/cancel/pause/Busy/interpreter-lock release. Both languages document the same supported behavior; preserve existing workbench recipes and old Python imports.

integration_tasks.title: Add upstream commands to the existing CLI
integration_tasks.acceptance: All existing commands/output schemas still pass; new upstream commands use canonical Rust operations, bounded JSON/I/O and create-new export behavior. No parallel executable or algorithm implementation.

integration_tasks.title: Reconcile dependency, example and delivery inventories
integration_tasks.acceptance: Validate local manifests/locks/version/pins/notices, examples and package member inventories without silently changing toolchains, two CI entrypoints or native target scope. Preserve caches and generated Python-guide policy; installed/hosted claims require separate actual evidence.

integration_tasks.title: Pass unified downstream and upstream backend regressions
integration_tasks.acceptance: Run full required MERLIN Rust tests/Clippy/format/analysis-only/doctests/examples plus actual Python/CLI/PNM compatibility and applicable Qt integration checks. Record deterministic values separately from elapsed time, all failures/omissions and exact candidate. Source-only passes are insufficient.

integration_tasks.title: Complete final documentation and skill correspondence
integration_tasks.acceptance: Meet all ten user documentation completion conditions: one architecture/requirements/checklist; complete requirement/task evidence; resolving links; skills name actual final modules; no obsolete user-facing branding; docs match implemented support and every newly accepted capability has local integrated evidence.

integration_tasks.title: Accept the unified backend within declared supported scope
integration_tasks.acceptance: Review complete requirement/acceptance and numerical/performance/provenance/license matrices for both independently executable directions. All mandatory children pass locally; retain limitations, deferred scope and native/hosted boundaries. No merge, release, publication or push is authorized by acceptance.

integration_tasks.title: Retain explicit future UI, wider PHY and ranging designs
integration_tasks.acceptance: Deferred outside this backend migration: upstream GUI, wider acquisition/confidence, fractional timing/phase noise, broad C/H/RxMER synthesis, finite-file transport and ranging/probe execution. Preserve detailed designs and evidence; require separate approval, source checks and implementation tests before exposure. This is not a dependency for backend acceptance.
